op.fellBackBecause: Opus rejected: The grow pairs the known 'enough' with 少し, both in the new LEGO ('when you understand enough' = 少し分かると) and as an explicit component. 少し means 'a little', not 'enough', which in Japanese is usually 十分. That pair is a mistranslation and not ZUT-safe: once 'enough' is taught as 少し, any later 'enough' prompt that needs 十分 will collide, and learners will produce 少し where they mean 'enough'. The seed's loose English gloss is fixed, but a reusable LEGO must not be built on it. Chunking up further to 言葉が少し分かると is 11 morae, over the 8-syllable limit. Meanwhile 分かると is already a sound, flexible unit of intention ('when you understand/know'). It extends naturally into many full sentences, e.g. 日本語が分かると楽しい or 意味が分かると簡単です, so the thin practice set is fixable with fresh phrases. The right move is topup on L2, not this grow.
